evidence: The provisional Design makes each new production boundary directly constructible and controllable: native authority and Design-sweep validation are pure value checks; terminal and wiring paths inject GitRunner, EvidenceStore, Clock/FakeClock, FaultInjector, selector/edge runners, and EventWaiter; host activity enters as closed observations rather than inline network calls. Exact public entry points, negative selectors, one-edge mutations, concurrency observations, crash seams, idempotent replay, and same-process/shared-resource isolation rules make every proposed branch reachable without monkey-patching internals or using a live third party.
